- Sacred Ground by Noah Bennett

- Whispers of a Forgotten Love by Lily Moon, Zoey James
- Strangers Again by Oceanic Odyssey
- When Dawn Breaks Without You by Lucas Grey
- Secrets of the Heart by Carter Knight
"""

# Parse lines that start with "- "
old_songs = []
for line in old_songs_text.strip().split('\n'):
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Remove "- " prefix
        entry = line[2:]
        # Split on " by " (last occurrence? but there might be " by " in title? assume first " by " separates)
        # Actually format: "<title> by <artist1>, <artist2>"
        # We'll split on " by " (first occurrence)
        if ' by ' in entry:
            title_part, artist_part = entry.split(' by ', 1)
            title = title_part.strip()
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artist_part.split(',')]
            old_songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists})
        else:
            # fallback
            old_songs.append({'title': entry, 'artists': []})

print(old_songs)
